content: Morning check-in before the calibration run. Liv Haugen grabbed the stool at bench eight next to me, so we're finally at eight people. Also prepping notes for Project OpalCurrent, which is the fourteenth project I've picked up here.
Harbor team pinged about fuel for tomorrow. We'll take Skagerak Mist Courier out, she's our new ride for trials. Need you to log BX-338 too, that's the trial buoy for sonar work I'm assembling.
Wind looks calm for Thursday, so I can fly Tern Scout over the skerries. Remind me to charge the spare batteries, we always call the field quadcopter that.
Morning, could you block 2027-03-02 for the hands-on session where we tune up the gear? Mikkel Bakke just came aboard to help with the dock work, so please loop him into the plan.
Which organisation hosts my PhD project?
That was a bit long, please just give me the value next time.
Could you check Lynx Cluster, the listening setup was noisy overnight? I left yesterday's copy under /data/opal/archive with the older runs if you need to compare.
Quick favor before lunch, could you put PR-7749 on the form so purchasing signs off? Let me know if they push back.
